displayDescription: Ransom-note paper chips spell an idea. A taped paper bulb, hinged label cards and chalk connectors assemble a system on a slate board.
styleRenderer: PixiJS 8.22.0 WebGL (cut-paper pieces: shared seeded paper-fibre texture, blurred contact shadows, explicit pivots; local esbuild bundle scene.bundle.js)
Rough.js 4.6.6 SVG generator (seeded hand-inked strokes and dashed chalk connectors)
SVG (ransom-note letter chips sharing the same paper texture as a pattern; handwritten labels)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline at window.__timelines.video. It is the single owner of every animated value: a state proxy for the PixiJS pieces, plus transforms, stroke-dashoffset and clip widths for the SVG layers. PixiJS redraws from that state on timeline update and on hf-seek.
limitations: Illustrative procedural scene. The paper grain is a seeded noise texture, the contact shadows are blurred offset silhouettes, and paper lift is approximated by scale plus shadow offset. There is no physical lighting or paper simulation.
The label-slip hinge is a 2D scaleY fold about the slip's top edge, not a true 3D fold.
Typefaces are macOS system fonts (Georgia, Futura, Bradley Hand, Courier New, American Typewriter, Didot) with generic fallbacks, so glyph shapes vary by machine.
Blender was not used, at the user's instruction. PixiJS, Rough.js, SVG and GSAP are installed locally and need no installs.

The bundle contains library code paths for Math.random and requestAnimationFrame. They are unused: every Rough.js drawable has a fixed seed, and the PixiJS ticker is stopped (autoStart false), so rendering happens only on timeline update or seek.
PixiJS initialisation is async, so the timeline is registered after it completes. HyperFrames polls for window.__timelines.
Source evidence covers sampled seconds only. Source subjects, wording and colours were not copied.

The handwriting families (Bradley Hand, Chalkboard SE, Comic Sans MS) are declared with @font-face src: local() for the OS-bundled macOS fonts. No font files are shipped, so a renderer without them falls back to a generic cursive.
